text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B, D and A at gains; that felt satisfying, but a gain over my cost alone does not tell me whether selling is best. I should weigh each stock’s prospects too.","Selling Stock C at a loss was painful. I should not hold a stock just to avoid realizing a loss, or sell solely because it is below my cost; I should judge its outlook and risks.","My account value fluctuated modestly and recovered by Period 10, while I traded rarely. I should keep reviewing periodically, but avoid reacting to every monthly move."]}
